claim_text: Provides at least 99% filtration and is classified as FFP3 under EN 149:2001+A1:2009.
evidence_excerpt: The evaluated ClearAir P3 configuration achieved a mean filtration efficiency of 94% in the recorded test series. The product configuration is designated FFP2 in this validation record.
product_page_html:
ClearAir P3 Disposable Filtering Mask

Single-use particulate filtering mask.

Provides at least 99% filtration and is classified as FFP3 under EN 149:2001+A1:2009.
reference_source_text:
ClearAir P3 — Product Engineering Validation Record
The evaluated ClearAir P3 configuration achieved a mean filtration efficiency of 94% in the recorded test series. The product configuration is designated FFP2 in this validation record. This record does not report an FFP3 classification or filtration performance of at least 99%.
verification_rationale: The validation record reports 94% mean filtration efficiency and an FFP2 designation, both of which conflict with the product page’s claim of at least 99% filtration and FFP3 classification.

claim_text: The GripShield M4 gloves conform to EN 388:2016+A1:2018 for mechanical protection.
evidence_excerpt: The manufacturer’s declaration of conformity identifies the GripShield M4 as conforming to EN 388:2016+A1:2018.
product_page_html:
GripShield M4 Mechanical Protection Gloves

Designed for material handling and light assembly work.

The GripShield M4 gloves conform to EN 388:2016+A1:2018 for mechanical protection.
reference_source_text:
GripShield M4 — Manufacturer Technical Data Sheet
Revision 3
The GripShield M4 mechanical protection gloves were assessed for mechanical risks in accordance with EN 388:2016+A1:2018. The manufacturer’s declaration of conformity identifies the GripShield M4 as conforming to EN 388:2016+A1:2018.
verification_rationale: The technical data sheet explicitly states that the manufacturer’s declaration identifies this product as conforming to the same standard named on the product page.

claim_text: The Vertex H2 conforms to EN 397:2012+A1:2012.
evidence_excerpt: The Vertex H2 has an ABS shell, a six-point suspension system, and an adjustable headband. The listed product information describes materials and fit features.
product_page_html:
Vertex H2 Industrial Safety Helmet

Lightweight helmet with an adjustable suspension system.

The Vertex H2 conforms to EN 397:2012+A1:2012.
reference_source_text:
Vertex H2 — Product Information Sheet
The Vertex H2 has an ABS shell, a six-point suspension system, and an adjustable headband. The listed product information describes materials and fit features. It contains no conformity assessment result, declaration of conformity, or statement concerning EN 397:2012+A1:2012.
verification_rationale: The reference describes the helmet’s materials and fit features but provides no conformity assessment or statement about the claimed standard, so it neither supports nor refutes the claim.
